findings.title: Send SIGKILL to the process group after the leader closes within the grace window.

findings.body:
**Count repeated assistant usage once per `message.id` on the fallback path.**

The assistant fallback adds `usage` from every `assistant` event (`cli.ts:1365-1367`) and never checks `message.id`. Claude Code can emit one `assistant` event per content block. These events share one `message.id`, and the reported usage can repeat across them (anthropics/claude-code#6805). The fallback is used when no shaped result usage exists, including runs cut off before a result frame (`usage.ts:23-24`, `cli.ts:907-908`). The inflated total then feeds the derived `costUSD` and the `maxTokens` stop decision (`cli.ts:908`, passed to `stopReasonOf`). A run that repeats usage across split events can over-report cost and can be classified against the budget too early.

Store the latest usage for each `message.id` and fold the distinct messages. Leave the result-frame path unchanged.
